Takuya Eguchi (Japanese: 江口拓也 Eguchi Takuya) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Eguchi was born on May 22, 1987, in the of , . As an adult, he became a voice actor and is affiliated with the talent agency . Eguchi provided his voice for fledgling Aspertia City Gym Leader Cheren in of . Then, he voiced during the Pokémon Origins miniseries.
